problem: Which equation describes the set of all points $(x,y)$ in the coordinate plane that are $5$ units away from the origin?
worked_solution:
The set of all points $(x,y)$ that are a distance $5$ from the origin defines a circle with radius $r=5$ centered at the origin, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13956996/assets/398adead10233d1af61cd9aa44f14d51eba9c195d30c9d6b16015a3391403908.png)

So, the required equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={r}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={5}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & =25.\end{aligned}
$$
